steps.name: 1 reproduction + control + engine smoke (ONE kernel, 12 arms x 2 games = 24 games)
steps.poll: KGR_DATASET=yiyangxudmm/kaggriculture-panel-bundle-sem4 KGR_STAGE=results/fresh/kaggle_remote_sem4 .venv/Scripts/python.exe scripts/kaggle_remote/remote_panel.py status sem4r   (every ~3 min until complete / error)

steps.name: 2 main arms over the 48 worlds (TWO kernels at once, 7 arms x 24 worlds = 168 games each)
steps.poll_powershell: $env:KGR_DATASET='yiyangxudmm/kaggriculture-panel-bundle-sem4'; $env:KGR_STAGE='results/fresh/kaggle_remote_sem4'; for ($i=0; $i -lt 3; $i++) { .venv/Scripts/python.exe scripts/kaggle_remote/remote_panel.py status sem4a; .venv/Scripts/python.exe scripts/kaggle_remote/remote_panel.py status sem4b; Start-Sleep -Seconds 180 }
steps.fetch: fetchcmd sem4a; fetchcmd sem4b (same env prefix)
steps.report: .venv/Scripts/python.exe scripts/lead_sem4.py report   -> results/fresh/lead_sem4_20260925/report.md (gap to leader per arm with 95% CI and n, all / clean worlds; T-T0 (exact removals), S-T, S-S0, S0-T, D-S, D+-D; team means; removals table; per quadrant; work ledger; per world)
